**4. Current understanding of the issues:**
- R1 (letters format specifier): Agent added `'letters'` to ALLOWED_TYPES with `[a-zA-Z]+`. This seems correct syntax-wise, but test_letters fails.
- R2 (__contains__): Agent added to Result class. Test test_contains fails.

The hidden tests require backward compatibility.
